Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent repeatedly executed the exact same search query ("Frank Skinner (composer) death place") across multiple turns (Steps 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) without varying the search terms or attempting to access specific databases like IMDb or AllMusic as instructed by the Planner. This repetitive behavior prevented the gathering of the necessary second independent source to resolve the conflicting reports (Hollywood vs. Beverly Hills) and ultimately led to an incomplete verification of the death location.
